Furnished offices for rent Warden and Steeles from $550

$550

Description

Fully furnished private offices in a professionally managed building at Warden and Steeles, available immediately on flexible terms. A single-person office starts at $550/month and a two-person office at $600/month, both inclusive of utilities, high-speed internet, reception, mail handling and access to a shared boardroom. Offices range from 100 to 180 square feet and the building offers 24/7 secure access, free surface parking and a ground-floor cafe. TMI is included in the quoted rent; a twelve-month term is preferred but shorter terms can be discussed for the right tenant. The building sits minutes from Highway 404 and Highway 407 and is served by York Region Transit on Steeles Avenue East. Please call or email to arrange a viewing during business hours; virtual tours are available on request for prospective tenants relocating from outside the region. References required.
